overview: Landlord restrictions in lease materials often focus on protecting the property's condition and ensuring safety, covering areas like alterations, maintenance responsibilities, and, for older properties, the disclosure of materials like lead-based paint. Common restrictions include limitations on improvements, unauthorized renovations, and adhering to safety standards.
